subject.question: Reconcile sponsor-reported direct XRP holdings, indirect XRP ETP exposure, assets, shares and custody roles without inferring flows from asynchronous balances.

executive_findings: Bitwise's official XRP ETF page reports 415,365,129.04 XRP in trust as of 2026-11-03. The same page reports $540,564,755 net assets/AUM and a $540,589,408.15 market value for XRP; the $24,653.15 difference is preserved as an internal page inconsistency rather than reconciled by assumption.

Grayscale's official GXRP page reports 64,839,534.7913 XRP in fund as of 2026-11-04, with $84,459,978 GAAP AUM and $84,445,908 non-GAAP AUM. The page names Coinbase Custody Trust Company and Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. as digital-asset custodians and BNY as fund administrator.
REX-Osprey's official XRPR page reports 19,885,382 XRP held directly as of 2026-11-03, alongside 362,750 shares of the CoinShares XRP ETP. The latter is an indirect ETP position, not 362,750 XRP.

The sum of the three issuer-reported direct XRP quantities is 500,090,045.8313 XRP, but it combines two 2026-11-03 observations and one 2026-11-04 observation. It is an asynchronous cross-sectional subtotal, not a synchronized market-wide holdings total, net inflow, or evidence of contemporaneous spot purchases.

Bitwise identifies Coinbase Custody Trust Co., LLC as digital-asset custodian and BNY as trust custodian. Grayscale identifies Coinbase Custody Trust Company and Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. as digital-asset custodians, with BNY as administrator. These roles are not interchangeable.

The two Coinbase custody disclosures are direct fund-level evidence of a Coinbase custody role for those funds. They do not establish Coinbase as execution venue, authorized participant, XRP buyer, or Ripple affiliate in these fund relationships.

The three official issuer pages are primary for their own fund disclosures, but the web-rendered extracts are not byte-complete raw HTTP captures. All observations remain model-ineligible pending raw-byte capture, SHA-256 receipts, independent timestamp anchoring and vintage-aware reconciliation.

limitations: Holdings and fund details are date-stamped 2026-11-03, not an intraday synchronized market snapshot.
The page reports $540,564,755 net assets/AUM and $540,589,408.15 market value for XRP, a $24,653.15 difference; neither value is silently substituted for the other.
The page identifies Coinbase Custody Trust Co., LLC as digital-asset custodian and BNY as trust custodian; it does not establish execution venue or AP activity.
Web-rendered content was not captured as exact HTTP response bytes in this research pass.
The holdings page reports 64,839,534.7913 XRP as of 2026-11-04; this is not a net-flow series.
The page distinguishes GAAP AUM from non-GAAP AUM; the values are retained separately.
The page identifies Coinbase Custody Trust Company and Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. as digital-asset custodians and BNY as administrator.
Web-rendered content was not captured as exact HTTP response bytes in this research pass.
The page reports direct XRP and CoinShares XRP ETP shares as separate holdings.
CoinShares ETP shares cannot be converted into XRP units without a contemporaneous ETP share-to-XRP look-through ratio.
The fund may invest directly or through an XRP subsidiary; the holdings page alone does not establish every underlying custody location.

bitwise_xrp.trust_custodian: The Bank of New York Mellon

strategy_exposure_disclosure.minimum_exposure_policy: At least 80% of net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in XRP and other assets that provide exposure to XRP.

limitations: The holdings dates are not synchronized to a common cutoff.
The set is not exhaustive of all US or global XRP ETPs.
Holdings balances can change through creations, redemptions, in-kind transfers, fee sales, corporate actions and price changes.
An increase in USD market value can occur without an increase in XRP units.
An issuer-reported XRP balance does not prove that all units are permanently unavailable to the market or that the fund has not lent or otherwise encumbered them.
The REX-Osprey CoinShares ETP position is represented in shares and must not be added to direct XRP units.

REX-Osprey states that the fund may use an XRP subsidiary, XRP futures contracts and swap agreements; the reviewed holdings table does not quantify derivative notional exposure. The direct-XRP subtotal is not total economic exposure.
cross_fund_reconciliation.direct_xrp_units_subtotal_scope: Issuer-disclosed direct XRP units only; excludes indirect ETP shares and unquantified subsidiary, futures or swap exposure.

custody_relationships.entity: The Bank of New York Mellon

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: The reported fund holdings represent XRP units held for fund shareholders at the stated issuer reporting dates.
competing_interpretations.evidence: The three issuer pages each disclose fund-specific XRP quantities and as-of dates.
disconfirming_or_missing_evidence: No byte-complete raw receipts were captured in this research pass.
No common timestamp or complete fund universe is available.
No wallet-level proof-of-reserves or independent custody confirmation was captured.

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: The sum of the three disclosed direct XRP positions is a current market-wide institutional XRP holding total.
competing_interpretations.evidence: The observations are from different dates and represent only three funds.
disconfirming_evidence: The as-of dates are not synchronized.
The REX-Osprey indirect CoinShares ETP share position is not denominated in XRP.

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: The holdings changes or USD values demonstrate new spot XRP purchases and net ETF inflows.
competing_interpretations.evidence: The pages disclose balances and fund values, not a synchronized creation/redemption or cash-flow ledger.
disconfirming_or_missing_evidence: Price changes affect USD market values without changing XRP quantities.
Creation/redemption and in-kind transfer records are absent from this snapshot.
Sponsor fees and fund operations can change token balances.

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: The three-fund direct-XRP subtotal equals total XRP-linked economic exposure across those funds.
competing_interpretations.evidence: The subtotal counts only issuer-disclosed direct XRP units.
disconfirming_evidence: REX-Osprey permits an XRP subsidiary, XRP futures and swap agreements.
The CoinShares XRP ETP position is denominated in shares, not XRP units.
Derivative notionals and subsidiary look-through are not quantified in the reviewed holdings table.

required_before_feature_admission: Capture exact HTTP response bytes from each allowlisted official issuer page.
Store SHA-256 digest and immutable receipt with source URI, capture timestamp and response metadata.
Record issuer-stated holdings as-of date separately from capture time and first-known time.
Validate each page's holdings markers and parser outputs against the raw bytes.
Retain direct XRP units separately from indirect ETP shares, cash, repos and derivatives.
Build synchronized historical issuer vintages and corporate-action/creation-redemption reconciliation.
Require independent source and vintage checks before any aggregate becomes a model feature.
